stemMd: A square plate has a circular hole through its thickness, perpendicular to the plate. The plate is parallel to the plan plane. Which plan feature represents the hole?

options.label: C
options.textMd: A circle inside the square outline

explanationMd: The plan looks normally onto the plate and along the hole’s axis. Both the square and the circular opening appear in true shape. Oblique viewing would alter the apparent circular shape, but it is excluded here.

distractorRationale.d: The opening is directly visible along its axis.
distractorRationale.b: The plate and circular opening are parallel to the projection plane.
distractorRationale.a: The opening changes the visible plan of the plate.
